subject: {first_name}, still picking from gut feel?
preview_text: One pick today beats ten opinions in the group chat tomorrow.
body_paragraphs: I wrote a few days ago about why we built Predictify — numbers over noise, published results, no hiding behind hindsight.

The users who actually get value don't spend an hour researching. They open one match, read the confidence band, make one call, and move on. Pick once a day for five days and you build a streak. Streak users are 3x more likely to spot value calls — not because they're smarter, but because they're consistent.
You already have the app. Today's slate is live. Take 30 seconds on one fixture before kickoff.
P.S. One pick today beats ten opinions in the group chat tomorrow.
